source: City of Buffalo primary/secondary plow street lists as published by Buffalo Toronto Public Media (2026-01-15), provided by the Mayor's office; priority order and emergency-access rule from the City's 2026-27 Winter Snow Plan as reported by WKBW/WNYmedia/WIVB (Oct 2026).
published_rules: Plow drivers focus first on primary roads, followed by secondary roads and then residential streets.
Primary and secondary streets include bus routes and access to emergency facilities (hospitals and other 24/7 critical infrastructure).
Goal: at least one plow pass on every residential street within 24 hours after a snow event ends.
limitations: Matched by street name inside the corridor; listed segment limits (e.g. Main: Goodell to Bailey) were checked only approximately.
The City's 2026-27 PDF street table (P/S with limits), garage assignments and plow districts could not be retrieved (HTTP 403); a later list may differ (e.g. Fillmore limits).
Bus routes are not modeled; hospital access is approximated by the corridor's critical segments near ECMC/BNMC.
Streets absent from both lists (e.g. East Delavan Ave, Grider St, East Utica St) are treated as residential priority; they may be maintained by another agency, which was not verified.
